title: Joomla! Core - [20261153] - Core - Improper access checks for category view levels in com_contact and com_newsfeeds in…
description: Joomla! Core - [20261153] - Core - Improper access checks for category view levels in com_contact and com_newsfeeds in Joomla 1.6.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Missing checks of the category view level in contact and newsfeed lists and in the contact content plugin exposed information about contacts and newsfeeds in restricted categories.
